items.mainDefect: The remote URL download in uploads_controller is capped at a hardcoded 10.megabytes and ignores SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb.

secondary.defect: The downsize loop never checks the boolean result of OptimizedImage.downsize, so it keeps retrying on a file that failed to convert and then saves a corrupt or oversized tempfile.
content_type is never set in the URL download branch, so Upload.create_for receives nil for content_type.

items.mainDefect: A second self.downsize definition overwrites the width/height version, which breaks existing callers that pass numeric width and height.

secondary.defect: OptimizedImage.optimize changed from separate width/height parameters to a single dimensions parameter, so any code calling optimize directly may now be broken.
